# For agents: this repo is GENERATED — do not edit it directly

`ourresearch/epistemic-futures` is a whitelist export of the private working repo
`ourresearch/epistemic-futures-private`, produced by `scripts/export_public.py` there. Anything you
change here is overwritten on the next export.

- **To add or fix corpus content:** work in the private repo (`~/Documents/epistemic-futures` on
  Jason's machines — the local directory kept its original name; the remote is `-private`), following
  its `dossiers/CONVENTIONS.md`, then re-run the export.
- **To re-export:** in the private repo, `scripts/export_public.py --dest <this checkout>`, then
  commit and push here. The script wipes everything except `.git` first and fails if any
  excluded material (third-party coverage, secrets, our priority judgements) would leak.
- **What is deliberately absent here** (never add it): third-party coverage of attendees, any
  evaluative commentary, prep notes, character cards, simulation output.

Read-only for everything else. Consumers (analysis, character cards, simulation) should treat
this as their only input.
